atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque GAME ROOM SPRITE ATLAS for Castle Survivor. Reference image is MATERIAL AND STYLE reference only, do not draw the exterior castle. Soft rounded SD 3D fantasy game style, warm restrained colors and thick readable furnishings. There are 1 different functional rooms in this order: grain sprouts, wheat sacks, dairy cheese churn. Each room occupies TWO consecutive rows: first row columns are its base, upgrade 1, upgrade 2; second row columns are upgrades 3, 4, 5. Then next room's two rows, same pattern. Base: simple but functional; upgrade1: add storage/workbench; upgrade2: add secondary production tool; upgrade3: improved larger apparatus; upgrade4: advanced working equipment and supplies; upgrade5: master grade productive facility, not just brighter color. Open front floor along bottom 15 percent for large NPC sprites, leave central walkway free. Full opaque wall/background/floor fills EACH rectangular cell to edges. No people, no creatures, no outside scenery, no castle silhouette, no wheels, no frames, no numbering, no signs, no UI. This atlas will be cropped into existing irregular castle sectors; broad legible equipment is more important than tiny decorative clutter. Use the reference castle's interior construction and warm material tones. Distinct visible functions: crops/tanks/milk in production, anvil/forge/prototype gear in attack room, tables/kegs/instruments in food venue, shelves/altar in culture room, lush plants/chandelier/banquet in luxury room.
